description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Microsoft Sysmon for Linux XML records relayed through syslog or equivalent collectors, covering Event IDs 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 16, 22, 23, and 26.

validation.validated_by: Hermes curation only; no validated/verified status stated
validation.source_log_version: Microsoft Sysmon for Linux repository/tests plus public parser/dictionary evidence; synthetic-equivalent fixtures only
validation.evidence: Repository schema/fixture checks exercise synthetic-equivalent Linux Sysmon XML payloads only. Event ID 2 file creation-time support, Event ID 22 DNS query support, and Event ID 26 file-delete-detected support are grounded in public schema/parser evidence, but live Linux DNS emission varies by kernel/build and is not validated. Local replay preflight is blocked by missing SC4S listener/Splunk testbed; no live Linux Sysmon relay, SC4S replay, HEC delivery, or Splunk read-back captured.

data_structures: One complete Sysmon for Linux <Event> XML record per physical line
RFC5424-style wrapper produced by the send helper for TCP relay into SC4S TEST

explicit_gaps: Live Sysmon for Linux emission, Sysmon policy/configuration behavior, Linux kernel/build DNS support, journald/syslog/file-agent wrapper differences, and multiline XML handling are not proven by this harness
Field validation with retained real product/source-version telemetry requires sanctioned host samples or a non-production Linux Sysmon feed

timestamp_policy.primary_timezone: UTC when SystemTime ends in Z
requires_source_timezone_when_fields_mis: collector relay timezone or syslog envelope timezone
timestamp_policy.notes: Fixtures use UTC SystemTime values and Sysmon UtcTime fields. Production relays must preserve timezone-qualified TimeCreated/SystemTime or document collector timezone.

field_delimiting.escape_policy: XML escaping; fixtures use example domains and RFC5737 documentation IPs
field_delimiting.notes: Each physical line is one complete Event XML record; multiline and journald-specific envelopes are not represented.

source.reference: docs/evidence/linux-sysmon-evidence-scan-20260608.md; Microsoft Sysmon for Linux repository/tests, SysmonCommon manifest, Elastic sysmon_linux parser, OSSEM/Splunk/Sigma corroboration for Event IDs 1, 3, 5, 11, 16, 22, 23, and 26.
source.notes: Fixtures use EXAMPLE users, example.test hostnames, RFC5737 documentation IPs, reserved example DNS names, and synthetic GUID/hash values; no customer Linux events or proprietary TA/config content are included. Event ID 22 DNS values are synthetic-equivalent and do not prove Linux runtime DNS emission on every kernel/build. Event ID 26 file-delete-detected values are synthetic-equivalent and do not prove Linux archive/no-archive runtime behavior without replay/read-back.

pack_variants.label: Sysmon for Linux XML relay
pack_variants.description: One-line Linux Sysmon XML records preserving EventID and EventData for process, file creation-time, network, file, configuration, DNS, and file-delete-detected families.
known_limitations: No live Linux Sysmon relay replay/read-back captured.
Event IDs 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 16, 22, 23, and 26 are represented; Event ID 22 DNS runtime availability and QueryStatus/QueryResults formatting must be confirmed in a local Linux Sysmon testbed.

pack_variants.label: Linux Sysmon JSON/journald collector relay blocked
pack_variants.description: JSON wrappers and journald-specific envelopes are future scope until exact collector wrapper samples are captured and field paths are proven.
known_limitations: Do not invent collector JSON or journald field paths without exact source-shape evidence.

cribl.notes: Preserve process, user, network, file, EventID/provider/channel, configuration, and raw XML/JSON envelope fields by default. Any suppression must be validated with replay/read-back.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: No live Linux Sysmon relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real endpoint captures.
Only Event IDs 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 16, 22, 23, and 26 are covered; broader Sysmon for Linux event IDs remain future work.
Event ID 22 DNS query coverage is schema/parser-evidence-backed only; Linux runtime emission may depend on kernel/build and QueryStatus/QueryResults formatting requires replay/read-back.
JSON collector variants and journald-specific envelopes are blocked until exact source-shape evidence exists.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
